verdict.rationale: Docs confirm test-mode simulation of purchases before going live ('Simulate test purchases before going live') and general Stripe test/sandbox conventions, which would let an AI-native user integrate and validate flows without touching production. However, there's no explicit documentation of a dedicated sandbox environment separate from test-mode API keys, no detail on test data isolation specifics, and no independent/hands-on confirmation of sandbox behavior. missing for 10: explicit sandbox/test-mode architecture details, independent verification of test-vs-production data isolation, and confirmation that AI agent workflows (e.g., via MCP) can safely target test mode.
